title: Smelling like a Zombie
author: Temmun OrangeVillager842
pages: One of the first questions of the Kolaps is “Why don’t Zombies attack each other?” These creatures attack every villager that they can get their hands on, so how do they tell the difference?
They tell the difference through smell. As you might notice, zombies have a distinct, horrible rotting smell. Zombies are deeply indifferent to the rotting smell while attracted to ours.
This creates a key way to be safe from the zombies, we just need to smell like them! Thus, if you concentrate the smell of a zombie and carry it around, you get a zombie smell.
You can focus this smell by coating a piece of wool with rotten flesh.
Firstly, rotten flesh tends to fall apart fast. The solution is to make compact rotten flesh by putting 9 together to strengthen the foundation.
Then, coat 4 compacted rotten flesh on a piece of wool on a stick and then put in inventory to create the smell. Zombies should avoid you for a few minutes.
